scope: Read-only independent review of parent-authored signed-release GitHub environment guard; does not self-approve this actor's NSIS implementation
checks: Signed job is tag-only, depends on unsigned package/smoke, and uses the public-release environment.

Environment checks require independent reviewer presence, prevent_self_review, can_admins_bypass false, custom policies and exactly one tag policy named v*; absent fields or API failures abort before signing credentials are provided.
Identified missing actions:read for environment API reads; parent added it and current source contains contents:write plus actions:read only.
Signing certificate/password appear only in package:dir and dist:win step env. npm ci does not receive those secrets. Approval guard sees only a boolean for secret availability.
Pinned actions and persist-credentials:false remain present; release metadata and artifact hashes are checked before gh release create with verify-tag.
limitations: No GitHub repository/environment/API state was changed or verified live by this actor; no tag, workflow dispatch, release creation, signing or installer execution occurred.

GitHub current REST documentation examples omit can_admins_bypass; guard safely rejects missing/non-false values. Actual remote environment response and owner configuration must be verified before a future formal run; source review does not prove the environment exists or has independent reviewers.

License/ownership, exact binary-source compliance, certificate availability, historical upgrade migration and clean Windows11 manual acceptance remain separate release blockers. This scope does not convert overall formal-release FAIL into PASS.
NSIS runtime safety is pending separate independent QA and parent-owned disposable actual install/reinstall/uninstall tests; compile-only success is insufficient.
